path.description: The video's path on this machine, an https address, or a YouTube link.

question.description: What to ask about the video, in the language the answer should come back in.

fps.description: Frames taken from each second of the video.

maxFrames.description: The most frames taken from one video; a picture costs the node about 300 tokens.

speech.description: Whether what is said in the video is read as well as what is shown.
